stories.title: Crimean Bridge
stories.summary: The Crimean Bridge is struck by Ukrainian drones for the second day in a row, killing two people and prompting Russian authorities to close vehicle traffic again. Open-source intelligence report that a section of the road bridge damaged yesterday has collapsed into the Kerch Strait.
stories.about: The Crimean Bridge, also called Kerch Strait Bridge or Kerch Bridge, is a double road and rail bridge spanning the Kerch Strait between the Taman Peninsula of Krasnodar Krai in Russia and the Kerch Peninsula of Crimea. It consists of a four-lane road bridge, whose main span was destroyed in 2026 by a Ukrainian attack, and a double-track railway bridge. Built by Russia after its 2014 annexation of Crimea, the bridge cost ₽227.92 billion (€3.23 billion) and has a length of 19 km (12 mi), making it the longest bridge in Europe and the longest bridge constructed by Russia.

stories.title: Ramayana: Part 1
stories.about: Ramayana: Part 1 is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language epic mythological film directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, the film is based on the Hindu epic Ramayana by Valmiki. It is the first instalment of a two-part film series, with Part 1 being based on the first three kāṇḍa (chapters) of Ramayana, which chronicle the life of Prince Rama from childhood up to his adventurous 14-year exile. The first part features an ensemble cast that includes Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta.
